description: Déploiement GPS du HD-THD selon l'ARCEP - T1 2026 is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Données de connectivité sur le territoire de GPS issu de l'Observatoire Haut Débit -Très Haut Débit de l'ARCEP. L'objectif pour fin 2022: connectivité à 100%. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal shows 23 records. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
